integrity: The Markov partition and general transfer spectrum are credited to the defining source. Claims of exact signed correlations, finite-time sign-sum variance and coarse-process non-Markovity are supported by explicit symbolic calculations and standard finite-state limit theory. No independent audit has been performed. The one-step-matched two-state Markov surrogate overestimates sign-sum variance by sqrt(3), as verified algebraically.
scientific_limitations: Stationary absolutely continuous initialization only; no claim for nonstationary trajectories.
Exact formulas at the symmetric six-cell postcritical Markov parameter only.
The Markov partition and transfer-matrix spectral framework were known from Horan (2019).
Potential equivalent sign-observable computations in unindexed literature remain unchecked.
title: Exact oscillatory sign memory and a finite-leakage diffusion coefficient for a paired tent map
